_help: Input overrides keyed by file name, stem or slug. Change DEFAULT_PLAN settings, replace steps or add extra_steps: [seconds, action, args...]. Actions: shot <name>, tap <button> [ms], down <buttons...>, up <buttons...>, release. quiet: [[from, to], ...] suppresses default inputs; skip: <reason> skips a game.
